reason: Adopt Graphiti v0.29.3 with Neo4j Community as Yance's authoritative temporal relationship-fact graph for people/topic/event relations, episode provenance, temporal validity/invalidation and Relationship Timeline factual projection. Letta remains long-term person/interaction memory and Parlant remains Goal/Journey authority. Yance supplies only thin Graphiti-specific lifecycle, credential, projection and portable-sealing adapters; it must not implement a duplicate temporal graph, supersession algorithm, graph database, model gateway or generic sidecar framework.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Apply the repository normalizeChangedFiles contract: require exact repository-relative normalized paths, discard invalid paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().
digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join the normalized sorted unique path list with LF and append exactly one trailing LF before hashing.

graphiti.integration: Official graphiti-core source/dependency lock at the exact commit; no fork and no copied temporal invalidation/supersession algorithm.

neo4jCommunity.windowsDistribution: Official Community Edition Windows ZIP for Neo4j 2026.07.1

temurin.role: Prebuilt Java 21 runtime for the sealed Neo4j Windows resource bundle.

uv.role: Build/sealing time only; not required by shipped application startup.

pythonBuildStandalone.role: Prebuilt CPython 3.12.13 runtime for the sealed Graphiti Windows resource bundle.

providerBoundary.provider: OpenRouter through Graphiti native OpenAI-compatible clients
providerBoundary.credentialFlow: Yance credential authority -> Electron main -> Graphiti child process environment

mandatoryFailureFirstContracts: No usable sealed Graphiti runtime or Neo4j runtime is causal RED; Yance must fail closed/degrade rather than silently bypass temporal relationship memory.
Any Graphiti or Neo4j listener that is not loopback-only is RED.
Neo4j HTTP connector being enabled is RED; only authenticated loopback Bolt is allowed.
Neo4j must use a per-runtime high-entropy credential that never reaches renderer state, persistent plaintext state or logs.
Graphiti HTTP must use per-runtime high-entropy Yance ownership authentication and reject unauthenticated or local-impostor access.
OPENROUTER_API_KEY plaintext reaching renderer state, persistent Yance state or logs is RED.
Every real relationship event admitted to temporal memory must be recorded through Graphiti add_episode with stable relationship group_id, source provenance and reference time.
SQLite must not independently infer or create competing fact/inference timeline truth without Graphiti episode provenance.
Fact validity, invalidation and supersession must come from Graphiti native temporal graph behavior rather than a Yance reimplementation.
Relationship isolation must prevent one relationship group from reading another relationship's Graphiti facts.
Graphiti-derived recall must enter the existing Yance reply-context projection without bypassing Yance final reply decision or send authority.
Letta long-term person memory and Parlant Goal/Journey authority must remain unchanged.
Application startup must not require online package/source resolution, pip install, uv sync, Git checkout, Java download, Neo4j download or system Python.
Graphiti/provider/Neo4j failure must surface an explicit degraded/error state and must not silently fall back to an independent SQLite factual extractor.
Graphiti must use explicit OpenRouter-compatible model identifiers; provider/model fallback that changes authority or provenance silently is RED.
Exact Graphiti, Neo4j, Temurin, uv, python-build-standalone and CPython provenance/license evidence plus deterministic runtime SBOM must be complete before GREEN.

Neo4j 2026.07.1 Windows Community artifact must come from a first-party Neo4j distribution path and have a first-party SHA-256 resolved and verified before sealing; absent, unverifiable or mismatched checksum is hard RED.
Windows x64 portable runtime must be built from exact sealed OSS inputs and pass offline startup/import/Neo4j/Graphiti authenticated health closure without build tools present in the runtime bundle.
The final implementation changed-path set must remain within these 16 exact paths and retain SHA-256 b27428408bf78dc2cf515547e0cf03d1281ee31a7ba4e6706345e161fad05754.
Independent exact-Head review must have zero unresolved P0/P1 findings before implementation merge.
